Any.description: The metamodel's any-value class (range of an untyped operational-node config).
Any.title: Any

CanvasAnnotation.description: Annotation keys a derived schema's header carries to declare its canvas twin (the dual-mode schema pack: LinkML master · .canvas twin · prose page). Each key names one Canvas Standard _reserved key the twin must carry; the VALUE sets are Canvas.aDNA's and are validated by canvas_std, never restated here.
CanvasAnnotation.title: CanvasAnnotation

ConventionAnnotation.description: Annotation keys that carry the conventions LinkML cannot express (aDNA.aDNA ADR-062 rider i). The values are the derived schema's; the keys are registered here so one validator can read every schema's conventions.
ConventionAnnotation.title: ConventionAnnotation

DataMappingEntry.description: One entry of an edge's data_mapping simple dict.

source_output.description: A source output name (the simple-dict key).

condition.description: Condition expression; the edge is traversed only when it evaluates true. Makes the edge conditional for the cycle rule.

data_mapping.description: Source output name → target input name (AgentEdge.data_mapping). A simple dict.

label.description: Human-readable edge label for documentation and visualization (AgentEdge.label). The profile's `label` slot, refined here to canonical's meaning (canon:lattice.edges.items.label).

port.description: An optional INFORMATIVE label — not wiring; data_mapping carries the wire (D-AC-17 (iii), ADR-004). Four meanings have been written for this key (schema: a source output; docs: a child entry node; full_therapeutics: both directions; slot names / branch labels); none is normative.

FairMetadata.description: The FAIR block — license, creators, keywords, and optionally a persistent identifier and a provenance note.

creators.description: Who made the entity — at least one person or organization.

license.description: SPDX license identifier or expression (MIT · Apache-2.0 · MIT OR Apache-2.0 · LicenseRef-All-Rights-Reserved). The pattern checks the SHAPE of a flat SPDX expression; membership of the SPDX license list is a lookup, not encoded at v0.1, and parenthesized compound expressions — (MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND BSD-3-Clause — are not admitted at v0.1.

persistent_identifier.description: DOI or other persistent identifier, when one exists.

FairMetadata.title: FairMetadata

FederatedEntity.description: Mixin for every class whose instances cross a graph boundary: a stable id, a label, the FAIR block and the sharing policy. A derived class mixes it in; if the derived class already names a different identifier slot, it keeps that one and id stays a required plain slot.

fair.description: The FAIR metadata block of a federated entity.

federation.description: The sharing policy of a federated entity.

id.description: Stable identifier of the entity; a rename changes the label, never the id.

label.description: Human-readable display name; may change without changing identity.

FederatedEntity.title: FederatedEntity

FederationPolicy.description: The sharing policy — whether the entity may be published, where it originates, and how updates propagate.

shareable.description: True when the entity may be published to the federation. Validity admits either value; publication requires true, and that is the publishing registry's check (template_registry Federation Readiness Checklist), not the schema's.

source_instance.description: The graph or instance the entity originates from, as a graph slug.

FederationPolicy.title: FederationPolicy

GeneratedArtifact.description: One generated artifact — its kind, path, generator pin, source version, and byte witness.

artifact_md5.description: md5 of the artifact bytes at publication — the byte-stability witness.

artifact_path.description: Path of the artifact, relative to the schema file.

generated_by.description: The generator and toolchain pin that produced the artifact, as <generator>@linkml==<version>.

source_schema_version.description: The schema version the artifact was generated from.

GeneratedArtifact.title: GeneratedArtifact

GeneratedArtifactKind.description: The kinds of artifact the pinned toolchain generates from a derived schema and publishes by reference.
GeneratedArtifactKind.title: GeneratedArtifactKind
